messages.subject: Re: Using R package xlsx to access cell comments from Excel file
messages.subject_clean: Using R package xlsx to access cell comments from Excel file
messages.body_plain:
Hi David,

Sorry to reply so late.  Maybe you figured it out in the meanwhile.

Not all the columns in your table had a comment, so your loop was failing.

    cells <- getCells(comment.row, colIndex=1:5)

    comments <- NULL
    for (cell in cells) {
      aux <- getCellComment(cell)
      if (!is.null(aux))                               # sometimes aux is NULL!  you missed that
        comments <- c(comments, aux$getString()$getString())
    }

   This is not probably what you want, but at least you know where the error was.

In the future please send correspondence about the package to r-packa...@googlegroups.com.  Maybe somebody else can step forward and help you faster!  https://groups.google.com/group/r-package-xlsx

Best,
Adrian

Best,
Adrian

> I have been using your excellent  xlsx package to read Excel files into R.
> I want to be able to extract cell comments and use these to annotate dataframe columns.
>
> I have tried this using the attached script file and dummy spreadsheet but have got stuck.
> Since the command getCellComment() is not vectorised, I have tried to write a function containing a loop to extract the comments.
> However, this doesn't work, and I'm not sure why.
>
> Any help would be gratefully received.

messages.subject: Re: Error loading xlsx package
messages.body_plain:
Hard to say.  If it's still not working for you, try installing the
package from sources.

install.packages("xlsx_0.4.2.tar.gz", type="source")

That will do some more checks and may pinpoint the error.

If you fixed it, please send back what you did, in case it's useful to
somebody else .

Adrian
